tagline: Next-generation Data-Intensive Systems Group at USC
mission: We build data-intensive systems that learn, reason, and stay trustworthy at scale.
intro:
Led by [Ibrahim Sabek](http://viterbi-web.usc.edu/~sabek/), NEXDIG explores how machine learning, quantum computing, and large language models can make data systems faster, more scalable, more secure, and easier to reason about.

Our work bridges AI and data systems, aiming at intelligent, trustworthy, and high-performance solutions for next-generation applications.

cta.heading: Join us
cta.body: We are looking for the NEXt passionate and talented students to DIG with us.
